content: अनुमुद् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> (<ab>P.</ab> in epic poetry) .²1 To rejoice with, join in rejoicing or sympathizing with; मुदितामनुमोदते <ls>Bhāg.</ls> .²2 To express approval; तदेव राममातृभिरनुमोदितम् <ls>U. 2</ls>; approve, second, applaud; निषेद्धुमासीदनुमोदितुं वा <ls>R. 14. 43</ls>; to allow with pleasure, permit; अनुमोदितमाचार्यैः <ls>K. 77</ls>; अननुमोदिता मात्रा <ls n="K.">160</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To gladden, delight, favour, permit.
